algorithm: diffusion policy (DDPM-style action-chunking) trained on exoskeleton-collected demonstrations converted to robot-hand-looking video via a SAM2 segment/inpaint/composite pipeline
hand: Inspire Hand (12 DoF, 6 active) and XHand (12 active DoF)
headline_metric: stage-wise task success rate (20 eval episodes/task/condition, best configuration)
headline_value: average task success rate of 86% across four tasks/two hands (Abstract); e.g. Cube 1.00, Egg Carton 0.85, Tea(tool) 1.00, Tea(leaf) 0.85 [Inspire Hand]; Kitchen-knob 0.95, Kitchen-pan 0.95, Kitchen-salt 0.75 [XHand] (Table 1)
human_data: own exoskeleton-worn human demonstrations (unnamed); per-task trajectory counts: 310 (Cube Picking), 175 (Egg Carton Opening), 400 (Tea Picking with Tools, shared across hands), 370 (Kitchen, 4 sub-tasks), plus 100 additional for knob-closing
note_gaps: the diffusion-policy loss formula is not restated in the parsed method text; no aggregate data-collection hour count is stated, only per-task trajectory counts
operator_interface: hand-specific 3D-printed wearable exoskeleton (per-robot-hand optimized joint-to-fingertip kinematics), joint encoders reading exoskeleton angles directly (no visual fingertip retargeting), a wrist-mounted camera (ARKit-tracked wrist pose), and matching tactile sensors installed on both exoskeleton and target robot hand
retargeting_objective: no visual/kinematic-chain retargeting at inference; a learned per-joint regression model maps exoskeleton encoder values directly to robot motor values (calibrated by visually overlaying exoskeleton and robot at matched motor values), with the exoskeleton's mechanical linkage itself optimized offline so its fingertip workspace matches the target robot hand's forward-kinematics workspace
